`interface HoverSupplier`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.hover` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [HoverSupplier.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/hover/HoverSupplier.java)

Function that gives the single line of a text tooltip.

## Description

Give it to [`Node.hover`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-property-hover); the line is drawn by [`UI.drawHover`](/reference/ui/ui/#UI-method-drawHover).

## Learn more

- [Hover and tooltips](/use/learn/interactivity/hover-and-tooltips/#show-a-tooltip)
